titulo.estudio: Une correspondance formelle : Observer les formes

intro: Work out the tone, purpose and nuances of a professional letter. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Work out the tone, purpose and nuances of a professional letter. Tell apart claims, evidence and reservations; attribute each piece of data to its source before drawing a conclusion.
Watch out: conventional formulas frame the exchange; the conditional and nominalisations adjust politeness and distance. In this passage, «échéance» means «deadline».

frases.estudio: Afin de respecter l'échéance prévue, pourriez-vous nous indiquer si les annexes doivent être paraphées séparément ?
frases.alumno: To meet the planned deadline, could you tell us whether the annexes must be initialled separately?

frases.estudio: Nous avons d'ores et déjà fait parvenir les pièces justificatives demandées, à l'exception du relevé qui vous sera adressé demain.
frases.alumno: We have already sent the requested supporting documents, except for the statement we will send you tomorrow.
